Waitlist privacy

Updated November 5, 2026

This page covers the Box AI waitlist website. The app has its own privacy policy.

What we collect

The email address you enter. Our hosting provider also processes standard request data, such as your IP address, to serve this site.

We may also record anonymous events, such as page views, where you came from and whether the signup succeeded. These events don't include your email address, and we don't set cookies for them.

What we use it for

To tell you when Box AI launches and how to download it, and to understand which pages and videos bring people to the waitlist. We don't sell your email address or use it for anything else.

Who handles it

Your email address is stored with Resend, our email provider, which also delivers the launch email. The site is hosted on Vercel. Anonymous events are processed by PostHog.

Removing your email

Every email we send has an unsubscribe link. To have your address deleted, or for any privacy question, write to huseinhakim@iconmediaedge.com.
